title: The Number of Employees Which Report to Each Employee
summary: For each employee with at least one direct report, the number of direct reports and the average age of those reports rounded to the nearest integer.
inputFormat: Employees(employee_id, name, reports_to, age); reports_to refers to employee_id.
outputFormat: Columns employee_id, name, reports_count, average_age; ordered by employee_id.
tieRules: Rounding rule for exact .5 averages not stated.
edgeRules: Employees with no direct reports are excluded.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: manager 1 has reports aged 20 and 25 -> reports_count 2, average_age 23 (22.5 rounded up).
